Four bots at 1% each is not always 4 small risks ⚠️

If your strategies win and lose together, they behave like one bigger bet. In our (hypothetical) simulation, four strategies with the same edge and the same 1% sizing went from a median drawdown of 17% to 38% purely because their results became more correlated.

New on the blog:
• the formula for how many independent bets you really have
• a simulation of 4 strategies at different correlations
• why correlations rise when markets fall
• what a calm-period backtest misses
• how to measure correlation between your own strategies
